title: Parsing an Iterated Absolute Step
statement: Fix a natural number $n$, a modulus $k$, and a function $a:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. For every natural number $T$, bit string $w$, and lists $vs,vs'$ of natural numbers, if iterating the absolute parsing step $T$ times from $(w,vs)$ yields $( [0],vs')$, then there is a list $gs$ of arithmetic gates on $n$ inputs such that $w$ is its gate encoding, every gate at position $i$ refers only to earlier positions in the concatenation of $vs$ and the gates, and $vs'$ is the result of evaluating those gates modulo $k$ starting with $vs$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ iterations of the absolute step from $(w,vs)$ equal $([0],vs')$
